items.summary: Labor Secretary Keith Sonderling cited "multiple active federal investigations" around the two companies' involvement in the program Thursday.
items.summary_zh: 劳工部长 Keith Sonderling 周四提到，围绕两家公司参与该计划存在“多项正在进行的联邦调查”。

items.title: We're adding to our position in a hard-hit stock before important catalysts arrive
items.title_zh: 在重要催化剂到来前，我们加仓一只受挫严重的股票

items.summary_zh: 这是我们在周四的第二笔股票买入。

items.title: America shut out Chinese EVs. Britain welcomed them — and now faces a difficult choice
items.title_zh: 美国将中国电动车拒之门外，英国曾欢迎它们——如今面临艰难抉择
items.summary: Britain faces a finely balanced choice over whether to follow the EU in imposing tariffs on Chinese EVs.
items.summary_zh: 英国面临一个微妙平衡的抉择：是否跟随欧盟对中国电动车加征关税。

items.title: Media attorneys ask court for help in preventing White House ban until legal case is resolved
items.title_zh: 媒体律师请求法院在法律程序结束前阻止白宫封禁
items.summary: An attorney for CNN, MSNOW and Politico asked a federal judge to prevent the White House from banning the three outlets, saying it violated the First Amendment.
items.summary_zh: 代表 CNN、MSNOW 与 Politico 的律师请求联邦法官阻止白宫封禁这三家媒体，称此举违反第一修正案。

items.title: Little relief expected for gas prices ahead of Election Day, according to prediction markets

items.summary_zh: 预计 11 月汽油价格将维持在每加仑 4 美元以上

items.title: Trump says U.S. will not attack Iran before midterm election
items.title_zh: 特朗普称美国不会在中期选举前攻击伊朗
items.summary: Trump said talks with Tehran were “productive” as the Iran war pushes oil and gas prices higher and support for the conflict falls.
items.summary_zh: 特朗普称与德黑兰的谈判“富有成效”；伊朗战事推高油气价格，而对该冲突的支持度正在下降。
